sources.author: Oraimo Health Offline
patch_list: Hardcodes DNS lookup in OkHttp to fail locally with UnknownHostException, preventing any remote DNS or HTTP traffic.
Removes the splash screen countdown timer (0 sec wait) for instant application startup.
Prunes background telemetry upload services, aggressive keepalive daemons, and cloud activities from AndroidManifest.xml.
Forces network utilities to report disconnected and disables network change listeners.
